note: Ìbùdó plan v3, the child of Oshodi and Ojuelegba (owner, 19 Oct 2026). Each area is a real place set down at true scale (1 m = 1 m, north up): a real point (anchor_real, lat/lon) sits on a Gidi point (anchor_gidi, map metres, y south). Any Gidi point in an area maps back to the real point under it: that real street is its twin, photographed there. Study in ~/Real-world/research/google/ibudo/study/.

areas.name: Oshodi core
areas.real: Oshodi: the interchange, Oshodi Market (red sheds, the mosque inside), Oshodi Rd, the Brown St grid of shop houses, the rail and the trunk road side by side

areas.name: Arena market
areas.real: the Nigerian Army Shopping Arena: about 40 long parallel sheds on one axis, a central spine, stalls along the track edge

areas.name: Civic quarter
areas.real: Bolade, Oshodi: the Oshodi-Isolo LGA Secretariat, Bolade Grammar, Oshodi Comprehensive, Kuhul Islam school on open sand; Adeyemi St bus route

areas.name: Church St grid
areas.real: Oshodi west of the market: Church St and Oshodi Rd, a regular grid of 2-4 storey shop houses and compounds, a school on a sandy yard, the Methodist church, hotels, carpenters and truck-pushers working on the street

areas.name: Mafoluku
areas.real: Mafoluku core: the densest grain, long thin blocks on a tilted grid, sand streets, open drains with plank bridges, zinc kiosks, Oja Oke market, churches in the grid

areas.name: Airport Road strip
areas.real: Airport Rd, Mafoluku: a wide divided road with the hotel and bank strip on both sides

areas.name: Barracks and spare parts
areas.real: Matori: the NAFRC resettlement barracks (slab rows, courtyard blocks, open sandy field) and Ladipo / Paramo spare-parts markets against the rail

areas.name: Ajao-type estate
areas.real: Ajao Estate / Osolo Way: walled bigger plots, gates, palms, the canal with a green verge, a mechanic village

areas.name: Jibowu coach strip
areas.real: Jibowu on Ikorodu Rd: the interstate coach company yards behind red railings, booking halls, touts and loaders, a colonial office, buses leaving for the rest of the country (chosen over Ilupeju's factories: more life, and it links Ìbùdó to the rest of Gidi)

areas.name: Ìkòríta (Ojuelegba)
areas.real: the Ojuelegba junction: two flyover decks, five roads meeting, bare earth under the bridge with danfos and traders, Tejuosho market block, dense irregular small plots

areas.name: Stadium and slab estates
areas.real: Surulere stadiums: Teslim Balogun / National Stadium with the long panel fence and the BRT stop; Rabiatu Thompson-type 5-storey slab blocks ringed with shacks

areas.name: Surulere closes
areas.real: Surulere's planned layout: crescents, closes and cul-de-sacs with barrier gates, old rooming houses beside new duplexes, the tree-lined canal, Akerele St's night strip

roads.real: Agege Motor Rd (A5) at Oshodi, the rail beside it; the kerb lane a danfo rank
Ikorodu Rd / Funsho Williams Ave at Ojuelegba, on the flyover decks
Apapa-Oworonshoki Expressway on its raised deck, terminals inside its loop ramps (our angle differs from the real one)
the Lagos rail beside Agege Motor Rd at Oshodi, stalls on the track edge
Oshodi Rd at the market gate

roads.gidi: the west road (now 'Adekoya Road', to be renamed)
the cross road at Ìkòríta (now 'Akande Road')

roads.real: Church St, Oshodi (north) into Osolo Way (south)
